{{Quote|The Mandalorians made the mistake of giving asharl panthers to their Separatist friends. They've got no idea how to handle them, but we do...|Kondan|<ref name="TOR:PT"/>}}
'''Kondan''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a scientist working for the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]], where he was stationed at [[Kessan's Landing]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. During his time there, he discovered that the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist]]s had been given [[Asharl panther/Legends|asharl panthers]] as weapons by the [[Hidden Chain|Mandalorians]], but had no idea how to use them properly. He asked an individual to recover a live specimen from the Separatists for the Imperial scientists to study, which the individual did so.<ref name="TOR:PT"/>

==Behind the scenes==
The quest that Kondan offers is only available to Empire players.<ref name="TOR:PT"/>
